responsibility: Implements logging, pretty-printing, and .dot CFG dumping support for the selective scheduler. It formats RTL insns, virtual insns, expressions, availability and liveness sets, fences, boundaries, and whole scheduled regions, manages temporary redirection of sched_dump, and produces debug-oriented graph dumps for current regions or full CFGs with selective-scheduler annotations. This file is purely the selective scheduler’s visualization/debug infrastructure.
same_name_distinction: This same-stem source file provides the selective scheduler's concrete dump and visualization implementation, including pretty-printers, temporary dump redirection, and CFG/.dot emission. The companion header gcc/sel-sched-dump.h defines the dump-flag enums and declares those debugging and visualization entry points.
